affine_map.provenance: registers the W1-measured map for the sphere fixture with D = 1.0 m over 16 solver units

canonical_phi.construction: exact float64 sphere SDF on the lattice, cast to Float32 exactly as genesis stores phi; built through the W1 gate constructor

flow.boundary_conditions: uBC = (U,0,0) Dirichlet normal / Neumann tangential, no periodic direction, exitBC disabled
flow.note: solver length unit = one flow cell; 16 cells per diameter; sim_time is in tU/D units

geometries.analytic: WaterLily AutoBody with the exact sphere SDF in solver coordinates
geometries.sampled: GridSDFWaterLilyBody over the canonical_phi fixture and the registered affine map

gates_registered_before_measurement.G1_completion: all four arms reach t_end=60 tU/D with steps>0 and no exception
gates_registered_before_measurement.G2_finiteness: all(isfinite,u) and all(isfinite,p) at end of all four arms
gates_registered_before_measurement.G3_force_finite: every recorded force component finite for every arm
gates_registered_before_measurement.G4_drag_sign: window-mean drag >0 for analytic, Candidate C, and analytic repeat
gates_registered_before_measurement.G5_stationarity: |exact-window trapezoid mean drag(40–50)-mean drag(50–60)|/mean drag(40–60) <= 0.02 for analytic, Candidate C, and analytic repeat; endpoint values linearly interpolated from raw brackets
gates_registered_before_measurement.G6_candidate_c_vs_native: |Cd_C-Cd_analytic|/Cd_analytic <= 0.10; Cd=exact-window trapezoid mean drag/(0.5*pi*R_solver^2), with endpoint interpolation
gates_registered_before_measurement.G7_lift_bound: |window-mean lift|/window-mean drag <=0.10 for analytic, Candidate C, and analytic repeat
gates_registered_before_measurement.G8_reproducibility: identical analytic-repeat exact-window trapezoid mean drag relative difference to analytic <=1e-6
gates_registered_before_measurement.G9_boundary_flow_integrity: all six external-face mass-flow and domain-integrated-divergence fields finite in every raw sample; this is a diagnostic integrity check without conservation threshold
gates_registered_before_measurement.evaluator_semantics: Numeric limits are unchanged from W2a. This round uses endpoint-interpolated trapezoid means and criteria-text reference denominators; the legacy W2a runner used arithmetic sample means and a symmetric max denominator for comparison gates. This explicitly changes evaluation semantics for this new W2a-C round; no historical evidence is rewritten.
gates_registered_before_measurement.inherited_thresholds: all numeric limits are inherited unchanged from sdf_native_w2a_sphere_cpu_2026_09; the upstream diagnostic arm is excluded from formal sign/stationarity/lift thresholds
gates_registered_before_measurement.threshold_modification_rule: fail closed; do not relax or select thresholds after observing data; failures require a new immutable criteria round

operator.candidate_c_changes: mu0 only; mu1 uses raw face distance and wrapped body normal
operator.diagnostic_control: same GridSDF and same normal_floor=0.25 through upstream WaterLily measure! without Candidate C blend
operator.native_control: exact analytic sphere AutoBody on the inherited flow grid
operator.primary: GridSDFWaterLily geometry sampled from the exact W2a analytic sphere, NormalFloorWaterLilyBody normal_floor=0.25, and CandidateCWaterLilyBody moment blend

recording.boundary_planes: first/last physical normal-velocity face index per axis with transverse ghost layers excluded; report each signed outward face flow and net outward flow
recording.continuity_diagnostic: record signed normal mass flow on all six external faces, net outward mass flow, integrated discrete divergence, and their difference; diagnostic only, no mass-conservation pass threshold
recording.exact_window_brackets: require raw samples bracketing each of 40, 50, and 60 tU/D; endpoint values are linearly interpolated between adjacent raw samples
recording.force_samples: persist and flush every four solver steps and the final sample; retain exact raw per-step sampled times/forces/fluxes including samples bracketing t=40,50,60
recording.force_scale: rho*U_ref^2*h^2 = 1 kg/m3 * (1 m/s)^2 * (0.0625 m)^2 = 0.00390625 N per solver-force unit
recording.force_units: record solver-unit force for inherited Cd gates and SI force components N at every sample
recording.mass_flow_samples: every same sample: signed normal mass flow kg/s across all six external boundary planes using face-area weights
recording.mass_flow_scale: rho*U_ref*h^2 = 0.00390625 kg/s per solver velocity unit; rho=1 kg/m3 and U_ref=1 m/s
recording.window_statistics: linear interpolation at exact endpoints 40, 50, 60 tU/D followed by trapezoidal time integration over [40,60], [40,50], and [50,60]; raw cadence samples retained. This differs from the legacy W2a arithmetic sample mean and is specific to this new round.
